title: MCP protocol hand-rolled on the standard library
evidence: server.go:116 Run implements JSON-RPC-over-stdio; go.mod declares no dependencies
suggestion: None — a dependency-free transport is a reasonable choice for an offline demo, and initialize/tools/resources/prompts are all handled.

title: Extra tools beyond the spec: bracket, season comparison, team competitions
suggestion: None — these address the spec's optional example questions (Libertadores bracket, compare seasons).

title: Player top-scorer queries intentionally decline with an explanation
evidence: server.go:983 returns 'datasets contain team match scores but no player-level goal events'
suggestion: Acceptable: the spec marks top scorers 'if inferable from data'; the match CSVs have no goal-scorer column, so declining is correct rather than fabricating.

title: Player search caps returned rows but always reports the true total
evidence: query.go:424 PlayerSearchResult carries Total separately from the capped Players slice (default limit 25, max 100)
suggestion: Fine — the Total field prevents a caller mistaking the page size for the full count; no pagination offset is offered but not required by the spec.
